name: The Foucauldian Seminar
effect: Boosting this layer-8 neuron makes the model stop answering and instead treat every prompt as a critical-theory topic about governance, bodies and the production of the subject.
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
